comparison.objective: Lay a photographic scale beside an archaeological find on the floor of its cut; candidate finishes four inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Pose and place a reference scale relative to a find versus precision mandrel use, controlled impact and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: Scale must lie beside the find on the cut floor; exact tolerances are absent. Candidate requires four fractures, four recovered tangs and damage-free retention.
comparison.reason: Relative placement of a scale does not exercise the candidate's central contact-fracture ability.
